# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged  <sub>[v4 c27 P0](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island (over-harbour region)  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c37 P13](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer and former fisherman  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose Kerr is a tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome man with a Roman nose, clear gray eyes, and an open, good-looking face. For fifteen years, he let his hair and beard grow uncut and unshaved, resulting in a rippling brown beard that reached nearly to his knees and a thick mane of hair hanging down his back. After finally shaving, he revealed a smooth, firm chin.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P35](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0035)_

## Personality

Ambrose is a cheerful, sharp, and widely-read man with a clever sense of humor and a talent for storytelling. He possesses an uncompromising, resolute nature and a strong, unyielding will, which he demonstrates through his fierce political partisanship. He is also a natural dancer and a good-natured companion.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c28 P32](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0032)_

## History

During a heated political campaign fifteen years ago, Ambrose Kerr publicly vowed to refrain from cutting his hair or shaving his beard until the Liberal (Grit) party returned to power in Canada. He strictly maintained this vow for a decade and a half, growing a long, wild beard and mane of hair. Following a Liberal victory, he forced a local barber out of bed after midnight to cut his hair and shave his beard, startling his housekeeper upon returning home smoothly shaven. He eventually married his longtime friend and sparring partner, Miss Winifred Tolley, and moved into her house. He frequented the Seven Gulls lighthouse, sharing stories, debates, and musical evenings with Captain Saul Garrick, Hugh Carrow, and Nell Harcourt.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c16 P10](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0010), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c37 P4](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0004), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010)_
